case: PostgreSQL custom enum[] formula-shaped label re-import through LibreOffice Calc
contract: The native enum[] includes literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, comma, quote, markup, formula-shaped =1+1, backslash and SQL NULL labels.
Native type, array_to_json and array_send oracles pass; rebinding reproduces JSON and wire bytes.

The XLSX writer stores the full array as a shared-string cell without a formula. SQL-file replay preserves it under four standard_conforming_strings/backslash_quote combinations and leaves a sibling array intact.
Calc preserves exact enum[] array text through XLSX/ODS/XLSX re-save; each cell remains text and no formula is created.

native_export_test.command: rtk proxy env BOOKIEE_XLSX_REIMPORT_ARTIFACT=<absolute-evidence-dir>/source.xlsx cargo test --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract::value_contract_custom_enum_array_file_exports_preserve_labels -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

steps: Open source.xlsx and save as ODS with LibreOffice Calc 26.8.0.3.
Reopen the ODS and save as XLSX.

consumer_assertions.method: Python standard-library ZIP/XML checks exact A2 text, requires XLSX shared/inline string and ODS string types, and rejects formulas.
consumer_assertions.result: Full array text, including =1+1 and SQL NULL distinction, preserved.

remaining: Other spreadsheet applications, enum array shapes and the broader B3 matrix remain open.
